sn24.70:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || || Rūpe
sn24.70:2.1: kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Vedanāya sati || Saññāya sati || Saṅkhāresu sati || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || ||
sn24.70:3.1: Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā ti || pe || vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya || Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Iti kho bhikkhave yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ || tasmiṃ sati tad upādāya tam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Vedanā || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || Viññāṇam niccaṃ vā ti || pe || vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāyā evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya Adukkham asukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Iti kho bhikkhave yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ || tasmiṃ sati tad upādāya tam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Adukkham asukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Tatiyo peyyālo
